label: D1 late in episode (trial >= ~70) after an unrewarded a1 -> S2 rare transition
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), only after an unrewarded previous trial (99.7% of mass at in_rew=0), and almost only when that previous trial was a1 with a rare transition to S2 (82% of mass; prev_action=2 or common prev transitions carry ~2%). It is also strongly gated by episode time: no activity before trial ~60, rising through trials 70-99. All active steps have low model value (<7.13) and a positive a1-leaning policy logit; good=S1 is enriched but adding it hurts F1. Predicate uses only observed history (previous choice, state, reward) plus episode position. Dev: P 0.74, R 0.77, F1 0.75, mass recall 0.82. Most remaining misses are D1 of the window first trial (rel -3) where the previous trial is outside the window (prev variables unknown), so the true recall is likely higher; false positives are mostly repeated rare-unrewarded a1 trials, where the feature is weaker after a preceding unrewarded trial (excluding tv(reward,-2)==0 raises precision to 0.84 at lower recall). Magnitude varies with lower activations at the window start; not further characterized.
